title: More ways to use text models
summary:
New text model options, prompt-generated HTML, and two community tools joined the garden.

Added `openai-fast` for text and image input and `mirexa` for in-character responses. The `openai` model now maps to GPT-4.1-mini, while `deepseek-reasoning` uses MAI-DS-R1. The same PR added Cloudflare Workers AI adapters for chat, text and embeddings.

Added a Websim Worker that generates self-contained HTML from a prompt in the URL path. The text cache was also reworked to distinguish requests more reliably and preserve streaming response types.

The project listings now include Polynate, a text-and-audio interface, and Pollinations Task Master, a Task Master fork with CLI and MCP interfaces. Two PRs added Polynate to the listings.

highlights.title: A faster OpenAI option
highlights.text: Use `openai-fast` for text or image input, backed by GPT-4.1-nano. `openai-small` works as an alias. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=openai-fast).

highlights.title: Meet Mirexa
highlights.text: `mirexa` answers in character and can mark image prompts with `<t2i>` tags. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=mirexa).

highlights.title: Pages from prompts
highlights.text: A new Websim Worker turns a prompt in the URL path into self-contained HTML, with support for Pollinations images and linked subpages.
